messages.subject: stoprule SPEC.md delivered (brainstorm partial)
messages.body: Mechanism: the reviewer writes each finding as a sealed claim (verbatim quote plus concrete wrong outcome) inside its report, and a stdlib script in a new skill then checks quotes, demotes findings not on lines the last fix changed (late-found), has a fresh finding-grader agent that sees only quote, outcome and a frozen rubric confirm each blocker, and itself computes verdict PASS/FAIL, a Reviser brief listing only confirmed ids, and a fixed-format escalation at review 3, delivered as the additive command /sc:spec-panel-stoprule (brief substitution: perl -pe 's#(/?sc:spec-panel)(?![-\w])#$1-stoprule#g'). Predicted on S1: review-3 critical+major on the pre-registered label proxy mean 4.0 (5 and 3, bar <=3 NOT expected to be met, chance about 0.2, because the design does not rewrite reviewer labels), the script's own confirmed count mean 2.0 (3 and 1, still failing bar (c) at the point estimate), and growth after two fix cycles about 20% (bar <=44.4% expected met). Biggest risk: it converges by filtering rather than fixing (late-found demotion removes real defects by definition; filter-only falsifier F1b predicted to fire at about 0.7), and the brainstorm itself ended partial (debate blocked on 8 high invariants, 2 still open: grader-reply integrity and attribution at n=2 without an ablation arm), so owner decisions are listed in SPEC.md section 7.
